label: Papercup voice (Kokoro TTS, local)
description: Server-side local TTS for OpenClaw. Wraps Papercup's Kokoro sidecar so any OpenClaw channel (Discord, Slack, etc.) can synthesize voice without cloud API calls.

voice.description: Kokoro voice id. See https://github.com/powder-nomad/papercup for the full list.

lang.description: Kokoro language code (en-us, en-gb, ja, zh, es, fr, hi, it, pt-br)

modelPath.description: Override path to kokoro-v1.0.onnx. Defaults to the @papercup/voice-stack package's models/ dir.
